vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: notification
Version: 2.0.0

The skill bundle is a simple terminal-based logging utility that records user-provided strings into local log files within `~/.local/share/notification/`. Analysis of `scripts/script.sh` shows standard file operations for logging, searching, and exporting data, with no network activity or access to sensitive system files. While the script contains functional bugs—specifically unreachable code blocks in the `case` statement for the `export` and `status` commands—there is no evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or harmful prompt injection in `SKILL.md`.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: a local, terminal-first notification manager that only reads/writes files under your home directory and does not request credentials or network access.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (terminal notification manager) matches the provided script: it logs entries to ~/.local/share/notification, provides commands, exports data, and claims to work offline. There are no unrelated credentials, cloud APIs, or surprising binaries requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs only local CLI usage and the script likewise only reads/writes files under $HOME/.local/share/notification and uses standard shell utilities (grep, tail, wc, du). It does not reference system credentials, other config paths, or external endpoints. (Note: the script uses common Unix tools that are assumed present but are not explicitly listed in required binaries.)
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec or remote download. The skill is instruction-only with an included shell script; nothing in the bundle fetches code from external URLs or writes to system-wide locations.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables or secrets are requested. The script uses HOME to build a data directory under the user's home which is proportionate to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request any elevated or persistent platform privileges. It only creates and writes files within the user's home directory and does not modify other skills or global agent settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it stores logs and exports locally under ~/.local/share/notification and does not contact the network or request credentials. If you plan to install/run it: 1) inspect the included scripts (they are small and readable) before running; 2) be aware it will create and append to files in ~/.local/share/notification (you can change DATA_DIR in the script if desired); 3) the export JSON routine contains a minor formatting bug (it appends a literal "\n]"), so exported JSON may need slight fixing; and 4) run it as your normal user (not root) if you want to limit filesystem impact.
